mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) from the previous month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines from the previous month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% for three consecutive months signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of months when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1300), rising inflation and anticipated monetary policy tightening reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of months when UNRATE < 4.0% and HOUST > 1300, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of months when INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) from the previous month signals robust housing demand that supports consumer spending and corporate revenues, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of months when RSAFS increases from the previous month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) indicates a strong housing market that drives consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of months when HOUST and RSAFS both increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the past month signals economic weakness that increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of months when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
